encounters.cc: Difficulty writing and using utensils over the past year with gradual hand shakiness

lines: Difficulty writing and using utensils over the past year with gradual hand shakiness
He reports a gradual onset of hand shakiness that worsens when he drinks coffee, tries to hold a spoon, or signs his name.
He drinks a glass of wine in the evening daily, which he says improves the shakiness.
He also reports that the symptoms disappear when he is lying down.
- Ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily with meals
- Ferrous sulfate 325 mg (65 mg elemental) daily
- Calcium carbonate with Vitamin D3 600 mg/400 units twice daily
His father had similar symptoms beginning in his 60s.
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 20 years ago (15 pack-year history).
Alcohol: One 5-oz glass of wine daily with dinner.
He denies weakness, numbness, gait instability, or changes in speech.
Vital signs are: temperature 36.8°C (98.2°F), blood pressure 124/74 mm Hg, pulse 68/min, and respiratory rate 14/min.
On exam, he has a fine, bilateral tremor of the hands that is most pronounced when his arms are extended or during finger-to-nose testing.
His gait and muscle strength are normal with no rigidity.
Examination of other systems is unremarkable.

encounters.cc: Progressive numbness and tingling in feet for 6 months with difficulty walking and recent falls

lines: Progressive numbness and tingling in feet for 6 months with difficulty walking and recent falls

This 73-year-old male with longstanding systemic lupus erythematosus, previously evaluated in Neurology one year ago for hand tremor, now presents with a 6-month history of progressive numbness and tingling in his feet.
He reports difficulty walking, especially in the dark, and has fallen twice in the past month.
His past medical history is significant for gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD).
He takes he has been taking over-the-counter antacids regularly for several years.
- Ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily with meals
- Ferrous sulfate 325 mg (65 mg elemental) daily
- Calcium carbonate with Vitamin D3 600 mg/400 units twice daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 20 years ago (15 pack-year history).
Alcohol: One 5-oz glass of wine daily with dinner.
Physical examination reveals decreased vibratory sensation in both lower extremities and diminished proprioception at the toes.

encounters.cc: Progressive fatigue and shortness of breath on exertion over 3 months with unintentional weight loss

lines: Progressive fatigue and shortness of breath on exertion over 3 months with unintentional weight loss
This 74-year-old male with longstanding systemic lupus erythematosus on chronic immunosuppression presents for evaluation of progressive constitutional symptoms.
One year following treatment for vitamin B12 deficiency, he returns with a 3-month history of progressive fatigue and shortness of breath on exertion.
He denies any chest pain, palpitations, or syncope.
He also reports a 10-pound unintentional weight loss over the last 6 months but denies any changes in diet or appetite.
He takes ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily.
- Ferrous sulfate 325 mg (65 mg elemental) daily
- Calcium carbonate with Vitamin D3 600 mg/400 units twice daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 20 years ago (15 pack-year history).
Alcohol: One 5-oz glass of wine daily with dinner.
Blood pressure is 130/80 mmHg, heart rate is 92 beats per minute
His cardiac examination is normal, and there is no lymphadenopathy or hepatosplenomegaly.
Rectal examination reveals no masses, but there is melena on the glove.

encounters.cc: Sudden onset of severe diffuse abdominal pain beginning 6 hours ago associated with nausea and vomiting

lines: Sudden onset of severe diffuse abdominal pain beginning 6 hours ago associated with nausea and vomiting
The 78-year-old male with SLE, AFib, and prior essential tremor, B12 deficiency, and anemia presents with sudden abdominal pain.
The pain is diffuse, 10/10 in intensity, and associated with nausea and vomiting.
He denies any recent changes in bowel habits or rectal bleeding.
- Ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily with meals
- Ferrous sulfate 325 mg (65 mg elemental) daily
- Calcium carbonate with Vitamin D3 600 mg/400 units twice daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 20 years ago (15 pack-year history).
Alcohol: One 5-oz glass of wine daily with dinner.
His vital signs are as follows: blood pressure 150/90 mmHg, heart rate 110 bpm, respiratory rate 22 breaths/min, and temperature 37.8°C (100°F).
On examination, his abdomen is distended, with diffuse tenderness and guarding.
- Arterial blood gas: pH 7.28, PaCO2 32 mmHg, HCO3- 16 mmol/L
An electrocardiogram shows atrial fibrillation with a rapid ventricular response.
